parts.name: Root
parts.description: The group container. It makes a div with role="radiogroup". It holds the value and controls the roving focus.

props.name: value
props.description:
The selected value. When you give this prop, it is the source of truth, with `bind:value` or
without it. The component writes each change here and reports it through `onChange`.

Without a binding, that write stays local. Thus a parent that hears `onChange` and refuses the
change — it sends no new `value` down — sees the group move. The group then goes back to the
value of the parent at the next render.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The selected value at the start, for when you give no `value`.

props.name: onChange
props.description: The component calls it when the user selects a radio.

props.name: name
props.description: The `name` of the hidden input of every radio in the group, for form submission.

props.name: form
props.description: The id of the form of the hidden inputs.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables each radio in the group.

props.name: readonly
props.description: Shows the value of the group, and refuses each change from the user.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the group with `aria-required`, and marks each hidden input as required.

props.name: orientation
props.description:
The orientation of the layout. It sets `aria-orientation` and `data-orientation`, and it
chooses the arrow keys that move the focus.

props.name: children
props.description: The radios of the group.

props.name: id
props.description: The id of the group element. The component makes one when you give none.

props.name: element
props.description: The group element. Use `bind:element` to read it.

props.name: context
props.description: The state of the group. Use `bind:context` to read the selection from outside.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the whole group is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-orientation
dataAttributes.description: The group orientation ("horizontal" or "vertical").

dataAttributes.name: data-radio-group-root
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the group element.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the whole group is read only.

dataAttributes.name: data-required
dataAttributes.description: Present when the group is required.

parts.name: Label
parts.description: The accessible name of the group. It gives its id to the group as `aria-labelledby`.

props.name: children
props.description: The name of the group.

props.name: id
props.description: The id of the label element. The component makes one when you give none.

dataAttributes.name: data-radio-group-label
dataAttributes.description: Present on the label of the group.

parts.name: Item
parts.description: One answer of the group. It makes a span with role="radio" and a hidden radio input for the form.

props.name: id
props.description: The id of the hidden input. A `<label for>` points to it.

props.name: element
props.description: The radio element. Use `bind:element` to read it.

props.name: value
props.description: The value this radio writes to the group. It must be unique inside the group.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables this radio alone. The group can disable every radio at once.

props.name: children
props.description: The indicator and the content of the radio.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The accessible name, for a radio with no text of its own.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: The id of the element that names this radio.

dataAttributes.name: data-checked
dataAttributes.description: Present when the radio is checked.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the radio or its group is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present when the focus came from the keyboard.

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present when the radio has the focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-pressed
dataAttributes.description: Present while the radio is held down.

dataAttributes.name: data-radio-group-item
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the radio element.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the group is read only.

dataAttributes.name: data-required
dataAttributes.description: Present when the group is required.

dataAttributes.name: data-unchecked
dataAttributes.description: Present when the radio is not checked.

parts.name: Indicator
parts.description: The mark of a checked radio. It is in the DOM only while the radio is checked, unless you give forceMount.

props.name: forceMount
props.description: Keeps the indicator in the DOM while the radio is not checked, for exit animations.

props.name: children
props.description: The mark itself.

dataAttributes.name: data-checked
dataAttributes.description: Present when the radio is checked.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the radio or its group is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present when the focus came from the keyboard.

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present when the radio has the focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-pressed
dataAttributes.description: Present while the radio is held down.

dataAttributes.name: data-radio-group-indicator
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the indicator element.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the group is read only.

dataAttributes.name: data-required
dataAttributes.description: Present when the group is required.

dataAttributes.name: data-unchecked
dataAttributes.description: Present when the radio is not checked.
